rendered: The Section 6[1] row of Table 1[2] (Low-Co/Ni-Rich Cathodes) names the cathode NMC 811[3]. In the other ORNL study the paper describes, the NMC 811[4] cathodes had an areal loading of 2.2 mA h/cm^2[5] and were maintaining 80% capacity at 6C charging rate[6]. The corresponding NMC 532 and NMC 622[7] cathodes only retained 49% and 56% capacity, respectively, at 6C rate[8]. In short, at the 6C[9] rate, NMC 811[10] kept 80%[11] of its capacity, versus 49%[12] for NMC 532[13] and 56%[14] for NMC 622[15].
